summary.text: Weston Newton is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 120, in office since 2012, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Newton chaired the House Judiciary Committee and the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee in 2023-2024, when he was also first vice chair of the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the House Judiciary Committee.
